'''93D''' was a silver bipedal [[Droid/Legends|droid]] of unknown manufacture. He ran [[93D's]], one of the best known chop shops in [[Point Nadir]]. His services were costly, but considered worth the money. He had two extra arms and a scathing sense of humor.<ref name="SaV" />
